Test Case Description: Verify a registered user can log in
Preconditions: User is registered and on the login page
Test Steps:
1. Enter a valid email
2. Enter a valid password
3. Click Log in
Expected Result: User is redirected to the dashboard and their name is shown in the header
Requirement Traceability: REQ-001 | AC: Successful login redirects the user to the dashboard

Test Case Description: Verify a generic error is shown for a wrong password
Preconditions: User is registered and on the login page
Test Steps:
1. Enter a valid email
2. Enter an incorrect password
3. Click Log in
Expected Result: A generic 'Invalid email or password' message is shown and no session is created
Requirement Traceability: REQ-001 | AC: An invalid email or password shows a generic error message

Test Case Description: Verify lockout on the fifth consecutive failure
Preconditions: User is registered and on the login page
Test Steps:
1. Enter a valid email
2. Submit a wrong password 5 times in a row
3. Submit the correct password a 6th time
Expected Result: The 6th attempt is rejected with an account-locked message and the account stays locked for 15 minutes
Requirement Traceability: REQ-001 | AC: After 5 consecutive failed attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes

Test Case Description: Boundary: one above the per-transaction maximum
Preconditions: User is logged in with balance 100000
Test Steps:
1. Select the beneficiary
2. Enter amount 50001
3. Confirm
Expected Result: Transfer is blocked with a message that the maximum per transaction is 50000
Requirement Traceability: REQ-002 | AC: at most 50000 per transaction

Preconditions: User is logged in with balance 300
Test Steps:
1. Select the beneficiary
2. Enter amount 500
3. Confirm
Expected Result: Transfer is rejected with an insufficient balance message and the balance is unchanged
Requirement Traceability: REQ-002 | AC: Amount cannot exceed the available balance

Test Case Description: Verify OTP step for a large transfer
Preconditions: User is logged in with balance 50000
Test Steps:
1. Select the beneficiary
2. Enter amount 10001
3. Confirm and observe the next step
Expected Result: An OTP prompt is displayed and the transfer completes only after a valid OTP is entered
Requirement Traceability: REQ-002 | AC: A confirmation OTP is required for transfers above 10000
